title: Dewey Decimal Classification Tree
description: Melvil Dewey's 1876 system files all knowledge into 10 classes, each into 10 divisions, each into 10 sections — 000 to 999, infinitely subdividable by decimal. 500 is science, 510 mathematics, 516 geometry; libraries worldwide still shelve by it. Its biases (religion: 7 of 10 slots for Christianity) are themselves a historical finding about 1876 America.
